name: Kissy Cutie
source:
This is a unofficial sequel of Undertale, in the style of a dating sim.

Long ago, two races ruled Earth… but you already knew that. This is not the story of how monsters where trapped underground, this is the story of how they tried to return to the surface.
After they were freed, monsters tried to live along side humans. But as expected, humans didn’t exactly welcome them with warm arms.

With humans being attacked and monsters disappearing, the only chance for peace seems to be convincing the daughter of the mayor, the manager of the orphanage Frisk grew up in, that monsters are not as bad as they may seem. But strange nightmares seem to haunt you at night, and you are losing your determination.

Can you make peace between humans and monsters? What are these memories that haunt you? Can you free everyone this time?

[From [url=https://xocolatl-games.itch.io/undertale-kc]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作是《传说之下》的一部非官方续篇，采用恋爱模拟游戏的形式。

很久以前，两个种族统治着地球……不过，这些你早就知道了。这并非怪物被困地下的故事，而是他们试图重返地表的故事。
获得自由后，怪物尝试与人类共同生活。可正如预料的那样，人类并没有热情地接纳他们。

人类遭到袭击，怪物接连失踪。和平唯一的希望，似乎是说服市长的女儿，也就是弗里斯克长大的那家孤儿院的管理者，让她相信，怪物并不像表面看起来那样糟糕。可奇异的噩梦每夜都纠缠着你，你也正渐渐失去决心。

你能促成人类与怪物间的和平吗？纠缠你的这些记忆，究竟是什么？这一次，你能让所有人获得自由吗？

[摘自[url=https://xocolatl-games.itch.io/undertale-kc]itch.io[/url]]
